entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:1
segments: Who [is] as the wise? And who knows the meaning of a thing? A man's wisdom makes his face to shine, and the boldness of his face shall be changed.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:2
segments: I [say], keep the king's word, and [that] because of the oath of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:3
segments: Do not be hasty to leave his presence. Do not take a stand in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:4
segments: Because the word of a king [is] that which has power; and who may say to him, What are you doing?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:5
segments: Whoever keeps the command shall feel no evil thing; and a wise man's heart knows both time and judgment.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:6
segments: Because to every purpose there is time and judgment, therefore the misery of man [is] great on him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:7
segments: For he does not know what shall be; for who can tell him when it shall be?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:8
segments: [There is] no man who has power over the spirit to keep the spirit; nor power in the day of death; and [there is] no discharge in [that] war; nor shall wickedness deliver its owners.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:9
segments: All this I have seen, and I gave my heart to every work that is done under the sun. [there is] a time in which one man rules over another to his own hurt.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:10
segments: And so I saw the wicked buried, and they came and went from the holy place. And they were forgotten in the city, [these] things that they had done. This [is] also vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:11
segments: Because sentence [against] an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:12
segments: Though a sinner does evil a hundred [times], and his [days] be made longer, yet surely I know that it shall be well with those who fear God, who fear before Him.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:13
segments: But it shall not be well with the wicked, nor shall he make [his] days longer like a shadow; because he does not fear before God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:14
segments: There is a vanity which is done on the earth: There are just ones to whom it happens according to the work of the wicked; again, there are wicked ones to whom it happens according to the work of the righteous. I said that this also [is]  vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:15
segments: Then I praised gladness, because a man has no better thing under the sun than to eat and to drink and to be glad; for that shall go with him of his labor for the days of his life which God gives him under the sun.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:16
segments: When I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to see the business that is done on the earth; for neither day nor night do men see sleep with their eyes.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 8:17
segments: Then I looked at all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun; because though a man labors to seek [it] out, yet he shall not find it. Yea, further, though a wise one speaks of knowing, yet he shall not be able to find [it].
